thought.text: Let me verify the Vite dev server actually serves the frontend modules (this is the part that can take minutes to compile on first launch per the guide).

reasoning_content: Let's check the Vite server's configuration and how the frontend gets loaded. I'll take a look at the server section of the vite config and how the main app references the Vite dev server.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
cd /workspaces/workspace
echo "=== vite server config ==="
grep -nE "server:|port:|3036|host:|middlewareMode|hmr" vite.config.mjs | head -15
echo "=== how app loads vite (search for 3036 / vite import) ==="
grep -rn "3036\|vite" app/views/ config/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i vite | head -8
' 2>&1
